> Significant changes — new constitutive models, solver algorithms, audit or
> regulatory features — require the RFC process (see CONTRIBUTING.md). Open a
> PR adding `rfcs/NNNN-short-name.md` and link the discussion here, or start
> the discussion with this issue first.

## Summary

One-paragraph explanation.

## Motivation

Why is this needed? What workflow or standard does it serve?

## Detailed design

The proposed design in detail: data models, algorithms, APIs, numerics,
verification strategy.

## Drawbacks / alternatives

Why not do it another way?

## Unresolved questions

Open items to settle before acceptance.
